name: Librari
description: Librari connects your contract library to Claude. Once authenticated, Claude can list and search your contracts by keyword, status, or type; pull full contract metadata — parties, key dates, contract value, governing law, and renewal terms; read clause-level sections; and discover which clause and term types exist across your library. It is read-only and scoped to your own account, letting you ask questions, compare language, and surface obligations across your contracts in natural language — without leaving Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Librari to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Librari to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.thelibrari.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Librari MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Librari provides these MCP tools: get_all_clauses, get_contract, get_contract_sections, list_contracts, and search_contracts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Librari?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Librari in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.
Librari requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Librari is developed by Librari. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
